name: Dumbbell Triceps Kickback
summary: An isolation exercise performed bent over with a dumbbell to extend the elbow and target the triceps brachii in its shortened position.

setup: Place your non-working knee and hand on a flat bench to support your torso parallel to the floor.
Hold a dumbbell in your working hand with a neutral grip.
Pull your upper arm up so it is parallel with your torso and pin your elbow tightly to your side.
steps: Keeping your upper arm completely stationary, extend your elbow until your arm is fully straight behind you.
Pause briefly at peak contraction, squeezing your triceps.
Lower the dumbbell under control by flexing your elbow back to a ninety-degree angle.
instructions.breathing: Exhale as you extend your arm backward, and inhale as you return the dumbbell to the starting position.
cues: Pin your elbow to your ribs.
Pause and squeeze at full lockout.

common_faults.fault: Swinging the upper arm to generate momentum.
common_faults.correction: Keep your shoulder locked and upper arm parallel to the torso throughout the entire set.

common_faults.fault: Dropping the elbow below the torso.
common_faults.correction: Maintain your elbow elevated high enough that full extension places maximum tension on the triceps.

precautions: Avoid using excessively heavy weights that compromise strict elbow-isolation mechanics.
